name: Visual Machine Selection Lobby
playpoker pattern source: SSR'd Lobby markup with aggregate counts (All 20 / Ready 15 / Busy 5) and individual machine tiles.
lucky5 current approach: Direct launch into the game instance via generic routing.
implementation sketch: Implement an HTML/CSS landing view showing a grid of cabinet instances with live availability, letting users click a 'READY' machine to claim it.
user-visible benefit: Provides an immersive 'arcade room' experience where players choose a physical-feeling machine rather than a faceless web session.

name: Fullscreen PWA Standalone Mode
playpoker pattern source: index.html <meta> tags: apple-mobile-web-app-capable, apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style, and manifest.webmanifest.
lucky5 current approach: Standard web-app behavior, which can leave browser chrome (URL bar, tabs) visible on mobile.
implementation sketch: Add a web app manifest and corresponding meta tags to force standalone, fullscreen launch on mobile devices to hide browser UI.
user-visible benefit: Deepens immersion by removing browser distractions, making the game feel like a native app or a real cabinet screen.

name: Pre-hydration Asset Preloading
playpoker pattern source: Injected hidden <div> at the top of the body with background-image tags for all cards and backgrounds to avoid pop-in.
lucky5 current approach: Lucky5 builds cards via DOM (no PNGs), but still needs to load large retro fonts and cabinet wrapper images which may cause Flash of Unstyled Text (FOUT).
implementation sketch: Add <link rel="preload"> for the required retro font files (Arcade, VT323) and inline a hidden preloader for the cabinet PNG sprite before the main UI mounts.
user-visible benefit: Prevents layout shifts and jarring visual pop-ins; the cabinet looks perfectly polished from the very first frame.
